reply_text:
I posted the list in #strategic-pod as a reply to your message. It has five Vantorre Group ticket references:

1. #8841 (Mateo Quiroga). Sources: #strategic-pod (Jul 1), Moss digest 5/4 and Moss digest 9/30. The sources disagree on status, so check the ticket system.
2. #PD-8841. Source: Moss digest 4/27. It may be the same issue as #8841, but the sources don't say.
3. INC-4821. Source: #inc-vtg-hartford (Aug 3).
4. VT-55120. Source: #inc-vtg-hartford (Oct 14), the root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage.
5. #PD-4418. Source: Moss digest 9/15. The digest doesn't name Vantorre Group, so this one is unconfirmed.

I left out #4812 (Vantorre Mobility) and #PD-4402 (Quillfeather). The list covers only what you can see, so it may not be the full history.
